panic.panic_string: watchdog timeout: no checkins from watchdogd in 91 seconds
panic.interpretation: The retained base arm encountered the same Metal command-queue hang on macOS 26.5.2. The arm was not exclusive because another agent was reportedly running experiments, so it cannot establish whether the base alone reproduces the panic.

static_root_cause_evidence.path: begin_split_route submits component-bank miss reads before HotExpertSwitchGLU evaluates resident hits
static_root_cause_evidence.resource_aliasing: different logical slot rows share one Metal buffer per projection
static_root_cause_evidence.hazard: CPU preadv writes can overlap GPU reads of another row in the same Metal resource
static_root_cause_evidence.scope: retained component-bank base and PR18 candidate

co_tenant_confound.interpretation: A concurrent experiment may have overlapped earlier and exited after wedging the global GPU. The panic stackshot cannot confirm or exclude that sequence.

decision.next_gate: Add an exclusive-GPU preflight that rejects any competing Metal/MLX experiment, wait for a clean cooldown/reboot, then repeat bounded base and candidate canaries. Resource-level CPU-write/GPU-read isolation remains a separate software requirement.
decision.reason: The post-update base arm wrote no artifact and another agent was reportedly experimenting concurrently. The arm is invalid for both performance comparison and causal attribution.
